latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Fiverr — professional, AI-powered video editing and export.

- Instantly edit raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM under 500MB) with natural language prompts—no manual timeline editing.
- Automatic setup with anonymous authentication and session creation for quick start.
- Upload, edit, preview, and export 1080p MP4 clips to share in minutes.
- Built-in command and intent recognition for streamlined editing actions (cut, add BGM, export, check credits, etc.)
- Optimized for fast turnarounds for small businesses and creators—cloud GPU processing, no local install required.
